limitations: Study roles and strain labels are database annotations, not primary phenotype review.
Counts describe metadata links, not independent studies or unique tested organisms.
Study-specific labels are not assigned the reference entry taxon or a genome.
Multiple and slash-separated strain labels remain intact; no representative is selected.
A susceptibility-related title is a review flag, not a measured phenotype or resistance disproof.
Missing strain comments or species lineage are missing metadata, not biological absence.
Role categories summarize annotation labels; function annotations are not experimental signoff.
Primary-paper holds are local observations; no alternate route or NCBI endpoint was requested.
Earlier per-paper reviews remain authoritative at their stated scope; this audit does not reset them.
Source-owned assertions, biological records, pages, embeddings and prior snapshots are unchanged.
No sequences, exact variants, raw role strings, non-strain comment values, numeric AST or protocols exported.
